next.reason: Amendment 1 (X3.23a-1989) only added the function operand: 'the data item referenced by data-name-1 or by function-name-1 and its arguments, if any' (§1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR4); 2023's identifier-1 covers both, so that part is carried. The change is in the length. 1985: 'The evaluation of length must result in a positive nonzero integer' (§1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR4). 2023: 'The evaluation of length shall result in a positive nonzero integer, unless the REF-MOD-ZERO-LENGTH directive is set to ON, when the result may also be zero' (§2023:8.4.3.3.4 GR5), a restriction lifted; and a violation is now an exception condition: for a non-integer, zero or out-of-range position or length 'the EC-BOUND-REF-MOD exception condition is set to exist' (§2023:8.4.3.3.4 GR5), and with the directive omitted or off a zero-length result means 'the exception condition EC-BOUND-REF-MOD is raised' (§2023:7.3.23.3 GR1). GR5 a) also adds bit positions ('If the usage of identifier-1 is bit, positions used in evaluation are bit positions', §2023:8.4.3.3.4 GR5). Leftmost position, the sum rule and the omitted length are otherwise the same.
